cars.generation: VA / VAB original standalone road sedan generation
cars.variant: WRX STI — August 2014 Japan six-speed manual
cars.specification_market: August 25, 2014 Japan base WRX STI manual: 1994 cc, 227 kW / 308 PS at 6400 rpm, 422 Nm at 4400 rpm. Not S4, Type S-specific Bilstein/BBS equipment, US/UK 2.5-litre, facelift or special editions. Factory photograph depicts Type S and does not redefine base equipment. Engine code, cam/injection hardware and rear suspension type not explicit in this release are omitted rather than borrowed from GRB. LED low beams are not universally standard.
cars.summary: The VA WRX STI established Subaru’s performance sedan as a standalone WRX generation with a reinforced body, revised suspension and steering, and Active Torque Vectoring. It retained the turbocharged boxer, reinforced six-speed manual and multi-mode DCCD all-wheel-drive system, giving the STI lineage a substantially renewed road chassis rather than a cosmetic revision of the earlier Impreza.
